evidence: scripts/promote.sh:45 --  jq -e --arg id "$(jq -r '.id' <<<"$gate")" --arg sha "$RELEASE_SHA" --arg version "$RELEASE_VERSION" --arg hash "$CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_SHA256" --argjson run "$CANDIDATE_RUN_ID" '.status=="accepted" and .scope=="trusted-candidate" and .gate==$id and .source_sha==$sha and .version==$version and .manifest_sha256==$hash and .run_id==$run' "$path" >/dev/null || die 'gate receipt does not describe this trusted candidate'
docs/release-acceptance.md requires native gate receipts to include binary/archive digests and retained evidence; promote never reads executable_sha256 or binary_sha256 from receipts
scripts/test/test_promotion.sh builds gate receipts with only status/scope/gate/manifest/run_id and no binary fields, illustrating the accepted shape
findings.first_evidence: scripts/promote.sh:45 --  jq -e --arg id "$(jq -r '.id' <<<"$gate")" --arg sha "$RELEASE_SHA" --arg version "$RELEASE_VERSION" --arg hash "$CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_SHA256" --argjson run "$CANDIDATE_RUN_ID" '.status=="accepted" and .scope=="trusted-candidate" and .gate==$id and .source_sha==$sha and .version==$version and .manifest_sha256==$hash and .run_id==$run' "$path" >/dev/null || die 'gate receipt does not describe this trusted candidate'
findings.suggested_fix: Require target, executable_sha256 and archive_sha256 for native gate wrappers and compare them against the matching verified manifest target; retain human review of terminal/evidence records.
findings.title: Promotion accepts native receipts without executable binding
findings.why_it_matters: Native gate records can omit the binary/archive digests that the acceptance guide requires. Promotion checks manifest/run identity but cannot catch a mistaken target-executable digest in a maintainer receipt.
findings.validation_reason: c027114 promote.sh:45 checks run/manifest/gate only, while docs/release-acceptance.md requires binary/archive digests; current fixture reaches successful publication without those fields. Human acceptance incidence was not measured.

006-ISS-045 records the required bounded-process contract. cli/cli v2.102.0 uses go-gh v2.16.1; api ClientOptions defaults to no timeout. All four GitHub helper scripts currently invoke gh without a watchdog.
findings.first_evidence: scripts/promote.sh:91 -- gh api "https://api.github.com/repos/$repo/git/ref/heads/main" >"$output/main.json" || die 'main readback unavailable'
findings.suggested_fix: Bound every maintainer gh invocation with a portable process deadline, preserve exit codes and readback reconciliation, and test a stalled owned child.
findings.title: Release helpers leave GitHub subprocesses unbounded
findings.validation_reason: c027114 four helper scripts call gh without process deadlines; pinned cli/cli v2.102.0 and go-gh v2.16.1 document zero default timeout. Stalled network incidence was not measured.

evidence: DisallowUnknownFields only governs the decoded value; readJSON has no subsequent EOF check. Callers use it for inventory and overlay files.
findings.suggested_fix: After decoding the expected value, require EOF on a second decode; reject second documents and malformed trailing data, while allowing whitespace.
findings.title: Strict candidate JSON accepts trailing documents
findings.validation_reason: At c027114 with Go 1.27.1, actual make verify-release returns zero for the owned valid candidate manifest followed by {} (json-reproduction.json); readJSON never checks EOF.
